title: Sparse polynomial threshold representation
statement: Let $n$ and $s$ be nonnegative integers, and let $f$ be a Boolean function on $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ with values in $\\{-1,1\\}$. There is a real-valued polynomial on the Boolean cube that represents $f$ as a polynomial threshold function and has sparsity at most $s$.
